ngaap.notes: Reconciliation (exact): Net earnings + income tax expense (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + (earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax [+4.8] = EBIT; + DDA&A = EBITDA. So ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda differs from ebitda_pub by exactly that discontinued-ops add-back (4.8; extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added); EBITDA is a continuing-operations measure. adj_items.disc_ops = null (disc ops is excluded above EBITDA, not in the EBITDA->Adjusted bridge). Mapping: Gain on sale of businesses -> gain_sale; Business interruption claims recovery (2010 Gulf Coast oil spill claims settlement) -> legal_env; Charges associated with divested operations -> divested_ops; Business development (non-routine acquisition charges incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up) -> acquisition; Restructuring charges -> restructuring; Property donation / One-time employee bonuses -> other. impairment/pension = 0 (no such lines in bridge). Adjusted EPS bridge starts from diluted EPS from continuing operations; eps_items_after_tax_ps = 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above' + debt refinancing costs / debt-purchase interest charges (after tax); eps_discrete_tax_ps = tax reform savings + Alabama NOL valuation allowance + foreign tax credit lines. roic_pub in percent: company ROIC = TTM Adjusted EBITDA / 5-quarter average invested capital; first published in the FY2019 (Q4-19) release, which shows 2019 13.9%% and 2018 12.6%%.
